notes.title: TRAUMA MODE ADDED
notes.content:
-Added Trauma Mode, which has a written tutorial at the start of the mode
-Actually fixed bug where you would get softlocked in slide tunnels
-Some co-op bugs fixed

Trauma Mode:
-removes the parry
-shotgun costs health instead of ammo
-parry key trades combo for health
-no other differences and NO changes have been made to the main game outside fixing the slide bug, any other differences are exclusive to trauma mode (mostly changed behavior for a single enemy)

notes.title: SPEEDRUN MODE ADDED "I didnt know you could do that..."
notes.content:
-added a speed run mode, unlocked by beating the game, selected from the Mode Select Menu.
-fixed a warp bug
-fixed the sliding bug yet again
-added ability in the game options to toggle on and off the hitstun


removing the hitstun DRASTICALLY changes how the game plays, its a bit fast but its very refreshing

I HOPE YOU ADHD RIDDLED SPEED-BROS HAVE FUN WITH THE SPEEDRUN MODE

[i]its not really how I wanted the game to be played, I think playing for score is much more fun but whatever you guys ask I will give[/i]

notes.title: "Huh. Okay..." SLIDE ISSUE MITIGATED
notes.content:
OKAY so I think I finally actually found the line of code causing the slide bug, and while I don't think its entirely fixed (there's still one way to activate it I don't really understand) the way I've most commonly seen people activating it is for-sure fixed.

so that and a bug that let you shotgun out of the teleport animation so you could go flying through walls at insane speeds has also been fixed.

Have fun! and be sure to join the Discade Discord if you wanna share clips, speedrun times, highscores, or bug findings!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/DPBev8nVyM]Discade Server[/url]

notes.title: Once again, this time with vitriol (New Micro-Patch)
notes.content:
Hi guys, I finally decided to get off my ass and make a small patch to the game!

-MAYBE POSSIBLY MAYBE SUPER MAYBE the sliding getting stuck in walls issue is finally fixed, idk I've "fixed" it so many time I have no clue at this point.

-Stages can no longer be stopped from ending because the player wont collect a point during the stage end animation, there is now a timer that overrides if this happens (Uzi will very suddenly go pop and the stage will forcefully end)

notes.title: SLIDING ISSUE FIXED MAYBE?
notes.content:
Sorry for going quiet for so long, but I think I *finally* fixed any and all "getting stuck in sliding tunnels" related issues.

You should no longer get stuck in tunnels and if you run into an issue like that again you can post a clip/screenshot to twitter and tag @DiscadeProject or post it in the steam community tab to let me know!
